coreValues.title: Equality
coreValues.text: We promote equality by embracing diversity and ensuring that every child feels valued and included, regardless of background or ability.

coreValues.title: Integrity
coreValues.text: We value transparency and ethical behaviour, fostering a culture of integrity in all interactions and communications.

coreValues.title: Excellence
coreValues.text: We are dedicated to a high-quality educational and nurturing environment, continually striving for improvement and innovation.

coreValues.title: Practical way
coreValues.text: Our curriculum emphasises practical life skills such as problem-solving, communication and collaboration, preparing children for future challenges and successes.

coreValues.title: Achieving targets
coreValues.text: We set attainable goals for each child and work together to help them achieve them, celebrating both small and significant milestones.

coreValues.title: Interactive education
coreValues.text: We focus on interactive, hands-on educational methods that inspire curiosity and a love for learning in every child.

approach.title: Foundational Development Program
approach.text: Goes beyond traditional preschool education, laying the groundwork for essential life skills and equipping children for the challenges of tomorrow’s world.

approach.title: Montessori-based learning
approach.text: A Montessori-based approach with hands-on materials, so children learn through their senses and build independence.

approach.title: Thematic curriculum
approach.text: Each theme integrates cognitive, language, personal, social, emotional and physical development into one immersive experience.

approach.title: Visual, practical learning
approach.text: Children under 5 have a strong visual understanding, so we teach practically. Visual learning is everlasting.

faqs.q: What age can my child join?
faqs.a: Play Group is for 2 – 3 years, Nursery for 3 – 4 years, Junior KG for 4 – 5 years and Senior KG for 5 – 6 years. Day care welcomes children from 2 to 8 years.

A Montessori-based, thematic curriculum through our Foundational Development Program. By Senior KG it is aligned with the requirements of State, CBSE and ICSE boards, so children are ready for mainstream schools.
Preschool runs 9:00 am – 12:30 pm. Day care runs 9:00 am – 6:00 pm, so children can move from class straight into day care.

faqs.q: Can children from other schools join day care?
faqs.a: Yes. Day care is open to both Crossmaze students and children from other schools, and we offer pick-up from the nearby drop point of other schools.

faqs.q: Can I see my child during the day?
faqs.a: Yes. Parents get live CCTV access, and the Crossmaze Care parents app keeps you updated on daily activities.
Yes. In-house transport runs on pre-set routes within a 5 km radius of the centre. Seats are subject to availability, so please check with your nearest branch.

dayRoutine.title: Good morning
dayRoutine.text: A warm welcome at the door, then circle time to say hello, share news and talk about the day.

dayRoutine.title: Montessori work time
dayRoutine.text: Hands-on materials for language, numbers and practical life, explored at each child’s own pace.

dayRoutine.title: Snack and stories
dayRoutine.text: Snack time together, followed by stories, rhymes and plenty of conversation.

dayRoutine.title: Theme activities
dayRoutine.text: Art and craft, music and show-and-tell, all built around the theme of the week.

dayRoutine.title: Play and movement
dayRoutine.text: Indoor and outdoor play, dance and yoga to build strength, balance and confidence.

dayRoutine.title: Day care afternoon
dayRoutine.text: Day care children have lunch, a rest in the nap room and calm afternoon activities until pick-up.
